_comment: Shared cases for test/federationService.test.js and test/federationService.test.php. Response keys are canonical URLs: origin+path, then the query params sorted by name, decoded. A response is {text}, {json} or {error}.

forward: a muxed contract address (W, CAP-84) is refused with its own code
forward: a C-like string with a bad checksum stays unavailable
forward: text memo is passed through
forward: numeric id memo becomes a string
forward: base64 hash memo is accepted
forward: domain is lowercased, name kept
forward: text memo over 28 bytes rejects the record
forward: id memo above uint64 rejects the record
forward: memo_type without memo rejects the record
forward: unknown memo_type rejects the record
forward: account_id with bad checksum is rejected
forward: JSON array response is rejected
forward: federation server 404 means not found
forward: timeout on the federation server
forward: redirect on stellar.toml is not followed
forward: FEDERATION_SERVER only inside a table is ignored
forward: FEDERATION_SERVER with credentials is refused
forward: FEDERATION_SERVER on an IP literal is refused
forward: FEDERATION_SERVER with a query string is refused
reverse: name with matching home_domain and cross-check

reverse: subdomain of home_domain is not the same domain
